title: [Exploration in molecular mechanism of icariin for ameliorating postmenopausal osteoporosis based on estrogen receptor alpha-mediated regulation of mitophagy in osteoblasts].
authors: Wang, Ning; Cong, Nan; Liu, Xuan; Chen, Si; Yang, Jiao-Jiao; Liu, Nian; Dong, Yu-Xi; Zhao, Pi-Wen
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该文研究淫羊藿苷通过ERα-SIRT1/FOXO3a通路调控线粒体自噬改善绝经后骨质疏松，仅用分子对接初步验证配体-受体结合，核心为细胞与动物实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: This study investigated the molecular mechanism by which icariin regulates mitophagy via the estrogen receptor alpha(ERalpha)-mediated silencing of the regulatory protein 1(SIRT1)/forkhead box protein O3a(FOXO3a) pathway and its downstream PTEN-induced kinase 1(PINK1)/Parkin signaling axis, thereby influencing bone metabolism and osteoblast differentiation to ameliorate postmenopausal osteoporosis(PMOP). Network pharmacology and molecular docking were initially employed to identify key targets of icariin and potential signaling pathways related to PMOP, followed by validation of icariin's binding affinity to these targets. For in vivo experiments, 36 female C57BL/6J mice were randomly divided into six groups: sham-operation, model, estradiol(E_2)-treated, and low-, medium-and high-dose icariin-treated groups, respectively. In the sham operation group, some fat pads around the ovaries were removed from the mice, while the PMOP models were established through castration surgery in other groups. The drug administration groups were respectively given estradiol or icariin for continuous intervention for 8 weeks. Estrus cycle changes were monitored, while serum hormone and bone metabolism levels were measured by ELISA. Meanwhile, the femoral microstructure was evaluated using Micro-CT and HE staining, and bone anabolism was assessed by Western blot, Masson staining, and Goldner staining, respectively. In addition, mitophagy and expression of related proteins were examined by Western blot and transmission electron microscopy, while SIRT1/FOXO3a pathway proteins were analyzed by Western blot. For in vitro experiments, MC3T3-E1 cells were divided into control(osteogenic induction) and icariin-treated groups(low, medium, and high doses), with additional ERalpha antagonist and SIRT1 inhibitor interventions. Osteogenic differentiation and extracellular matrix mineralization were evaluated using ALP staining, alizarin red staining, and Western blot. Mitophagy and expression of related proteins were examined by Western blot and immunofluorescence detection, while the expression of proteins related to SIRT1/FOXO3a pathway was detected by Western blot. The results of network pharmacology analysis showed that SIRT1/FOXO3a was identified as a critical pathway to regulate PMOP, with icariin exhibiting high binding affinity to ERalpha. The results of in vivo experiments showed that compared to the sham operation group, the model group exhibited disrupted estrous cycles along with significantly decreased serum E_2 and procollagen type Ⅰ N-terminal propeptide(P1NP) levels, while follicle-stimulating hormone(FSH), luteinizing hormone(LH), and C-terminal telopeptide of type Ⅰ collagen(CTX-1) levels were markedly elevated, indicating successful establishment of the PMOP model. Following icariin intervention, the treatment group showed significantly increased serum P1NP levels and decreased CTX-1 levels compared to the model group. Meanwhile, icariin improved femoral microstructure, increased the areas of collagen deposition and mineralized bone matrix, and upregulated osteogenic-specific proteins, such as osteopontin(OPN) and osteoprotegerin(OPG). Icariin promoted the formation of autophagolysosome-like structures in osteoblasts. It inhibited the expression of autophagy-related protein P62 while upregulating mitophagy-related proteins PINK1, Parkin, microtubule-associated protein 1A/1B light chain 3A(LC3Ⅱ/LC3Ⅰ) and Beclin1, as well as the key pathway proteins SIRT1 and FOXO3a. The results of in vitro experiments demonstrated that icariin upregulated the expression of OPN and OPG, while promoting osteogenic differentiation and extracellular matrix mineralization. It downregulated P62 protein expression while enhancing the expression of PINK1, Parkin, LC3Ⅱ/LC3Ⅰ and Beclin1. Additionally, icariin increased the co-localization fluorescence intensity of LC3 with MitoTracker. Upon the addition of the ERalpha antagonist, the expression levels of SIRT1, FOXO3a, PINK1, and Parkin were significantly reduced, accompanied by weakened co-localization fluorescence intensity. When the SIRT1 inhibitor was introduced, the expression of acetylated FOXO3a increased, while the expression of PINK1, Parkin, and FOXO3a markedly decreased, along with diminished co-localization fluorescence intensity. In summary, icariin ameliorates PMOP by enhancing PINK1/Parkin-dependent mitophagy via the ERalpha-SIRT1/FOXO3a pathway, thereby regulating bone metabolism and promoting bone remodeling.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了淫羊藿苷通过雌激素受体α（ERalpha）介导的沉默调节蛋白1（SIRT1）/叉头框蛋白O3a（FOXO3a）通路及其下游PTEN诱导激酶1（PINK1）/Parkin信号轴调控线粒体自噬的分子机制，从而影响骨代谢和成骨细胞分化，以改善绝经后骨质疏松症（PMOP）。首先采用网络药理学和分子对接技术识别淫羊藿苷的关键靶点及与PMOP相关的潜在信号通路，随后验证淫羊藿苷与这些靶点的结合亲和力。在体内实验中，36只雌性C57BL/6J小鼠随机分为六组：假手术组、模型组、雌二醇（E_2）治疗组以及低、中、高剂量淫羊藿苷治疗组。假手术组小鼠仅切除卵巢周围部分脂肪垫，而其他组通过去势手术建立PMOP模型。给药组分别给予雌二醇或淫羊藿苷连续干预8周。监测动情周期变化，同时通过ELISA检测血清激素和骨代谢水平。此外，使用Micro-CT和HE染色评估股骨微结构，并通过Western blot、Masson染色和Goldner染色分别评估骨合成代谢。同时，通过Western blot和透射电子显微镜检测线粒体自噬及相关蛋白表达，并通过Western blot分析SIRT1/FOXO3a通路蛋白。在体外实验中，MC3T3-E1细胞分为对照组（成骨诱导）和淫羊藿苷治疗组（低、中、高剂量），并额外加入ERalpha拮抗剂和SIRT1抑制剂干预。使用ALP染色、茜素红染色和Western blot评估成骨分化和细胞外基质矿化。通过Western blot和免疫荧光检测线粒体自噬及相关蛋白表达，并通过Western blot检测SIRT1/FOXO3a通路相关蛋白表达。网络药理学分析结果显示，SIRT1/FOXO3a被确定为调控PMOP的关键通路，且淫羊藿苷与ERalpha具有高结合亲和力。体内实验结果显示，与假手术组相比，模型组表现出动情周期紊乱，血清E_2和Ⅰ型前胶原氨基端前肽（P1NP）水平显著降低，而促卵泡激素（FSH）、促黄体生成素（LH）和Ⅰ型胶原C端交联肽（CTX-1）水平显著升高，表明PMOP模型成功建立。淫羊藿苷干预后，与模型组相比，治疗组血清P1NP水平显著升高，CTX-1水平降低。同时，淫羊藿苷改善了股骨微结构，增加了胶原沉积和矿化骨基质面积，并上调了成骨特异性蛋白，如骨桥蛋白（OPN）和骨保护素（OPG）。淫羊藿苷促进了成骨细胞中自噬溶酶体样结构的形成。它抑制了自噬相关蛋白P62的表达，同时上调了线粒体自噬相关蛋白PINK1、Parkin、微管相关蛋白1A/1B轻链3A（LC3Ⅱ/LC3Ⅰ）和Beclin1，以及关键通路蛋白SIRT1和FOXO3a。体外实验结果表明，淫羊藿苷上调了OPN和OPG的表达，同时促进了成骨分化和细胞外基质矿化。它下调了P62蛋白表达，同时增强了PINK1、Parkin、LC3Ⅱ/LC3Ⅰ和Beclin1的表达。此外，淫羊藿苷增加了LC3与MitoTracker的共定位荧光强度。加入ERalpha拮抗剂后，SIRT1、FOXO3a、PINK1和Parkin的表达水平显著降低，共定位荧光强度减弱。引入SIRT1抑制剂后，乙酰化FOXO3a的表达增加，而PINK1、Parkin和FOXO3a的表达显著降低，共定位荧光强度减弱。总之，淫羊藿苷通过ERalpha-SIRT1/FOXO3a通路增强PINK1/Parkin依赖性线粒体自噬，从而调节骨代谢并促进骨重塑，改善PMOP。
